ability_level_cap.formula: min(base + PerLevel * level, cap) through level 200; cap + (level-200)*PerLevelAbove after cap level.

available_ip.formula: AvailableIp = Stats.GetOrZero(IP) - Stats.GetOrZero(UsedIP); Player wire value for IP is max(0, AvailableIp) after level IP bonus.

combat_weapon_damage_current.formula: Attack/defense ratings use template attack/defend lines plus AMS/DMS; hit chance = A*(attack+K)/(defense+L)+B with A=0.6944, B=0.11317, K=45.85, L=38.98. Raw damage types 90-97 map to AC/add-damage stats. CriticalIncrease rolls normal criticals except Burst.

computer_literacy_shop_pricing.formula: steps = clamp(ComputerLiteracy,0,3000)/40; buy = round(itemValue * sellModifier * max(0,100-steps)/10000); sell = floor(itemValue * buyModifier * (100+steps)/10000).

max_nano.formula: breedBaseNP + level * (ProfessionNanoPoints + breedModNP) + NanoPool * breedMultNP; profession IDs above 13 shift down one column.

ncu_usage.formula: CurrentNCU/UsedNCU is sum(active friendly buffs that consume NCU); capacity is MaxNCU.

skill_level_cap_and_cost.formula: Profession multiplier selects tier; title-start levels, tier PerLevel, and title caps set cap; raise cost sums multiplier_tenths * point / 10.

skill_trickle.formula: SkillCatalog adds floor(weighted ability total / 400) using SkillTrickle.json weights.

total_ip_earned_at_level.formula: if level < 1 then 0; otherwise 1500 + (remaining-1)*4000 plus bracket increments: >14 at 10000, >49 at 20000, >99 at 40000, >149 at 80000, >189 at 150000, >204 at 600000

xp_thresholds.formula: GameDataStore derives FloorXp cumulatively from Xp.json NextLevelXp rows.

generated_from.rules: No Ghidra, no new reverse engineering, no generic AO knowledge, no D:/anarchyonlinegodot writes.

partial_unresolved_findings.finding: ComputerLiteracy is proven for shop pricing. NCU capacity is read from MaxNCU; no current evidence proves a ComputerLiteracy-derived NCU capacity formula.
